en: An old monochrome postcard view of a large brick Gothic church with a tall spire and a smaller tower, surrounded by leafless trees and wooden fences in the foreground. The printed caption at the top identifies the place as Mühlberg on the Elbe River and describes the church as the "Altst. Kirche" (old town church). A vertical inscription along the right edge mentions the publisher.
